retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned 1970s studio portrait featuring a group in coordinated retro fashion centered around a peacock wicker chair with centered top-aligned serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four people (three women, one man) posed in a tight, triangular composition against a solid warm yellow-beige studio backdrop. The central figure sits in a large wicker peacock chair, surrounded by others in reclining and seated poses. The scene is cluttered with 70s romantic props like red roses, heart-shaped boxes, and faux fur, all captured with the soft grain and warm saturation of vintage color film.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular group posing centered on a wicker chair
Warm monochromatic background contrasting with vibrant green and red attire
Top-centered text balancing the heavy visual weight of the group below
coreInvariants: Wicker peacock chair as the central furniture piece
Soft, diffused studio lighting with gentle shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central group occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man in the hat seated in the wicker chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-centered text, moves down to the central figure, then follows the limbs of the surrounding women outward to the props at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space at the top and sides in a warm, aged yellow tone.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brown and black (hair and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, warm saturation typical of aged 1970s print media.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a closed loop descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist name and title, distinguished by case or size.
graphicDevices: Small logo in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft, rounded 70s serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and classic structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a 1970s soul group posed around a wicker peacock chair against a warm yellow backdrop, including props like roses and heart boxes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, dark brown serif text at the top of the frame with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered at the top?
Is the font a high-contrast serif?
Is the background a warm, aged yellow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the wicker chair has the iconic 'peacock' back
Verify the warm, slightly yellowed color cast
Confirm typography is centered and serif-based
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 1970s studio group portrait + peacock wicker chair + warm yellow backdrop + top-centered serif typography.
